h2. Description

In Tech View and Board View *the filter bar should offer a Technician filter right after Assigned to me*, so a user can show only the chosen technicians' groups or columns. On staging there is no Technician filter at all.

For example,
* the filter bar in Tech View reads Search, Status, Assigned to me, Asset on Site
* Board View's filter bar is the same
* so nobody can narrow Tech View or Board View to chosen technicians

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10044*) and the PRD.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* The filter bar reads *Search*, *Status*, *Assigned to me*, *Asset on Site*. There is no *Technician* filter.
# Click *Board View* in the display switcher.
#* The filter bar is the same: no *Technician* filter.
# Click *List* in the display switcher.
#* No *Technician* filter, which is right for List.

*Actual Result:*
* Tech View and Board View offer no Technician filter.

*Expected Result:*
* Tech View and Board View offer a Technician filter after Assigned to me, as the test cases expect: *"Step 4: Tech View's filter bar shows a Technician filter after Assigned to me (to its right). It shows no Department filter, and no Customer or Service Advisor filter."*
